messages:
maria: Customer X just finished BYOK import. They want: 1) HSM wrap/unwrap sent to their SIEM over TLS syslog (6514), 2) only two named operators can perform rewraps, 3) logs retained 7y, include firmware hash for attestation. Thoughts?

samir: RBAC: we can add a scoped `byok_rewrap_operator` role + require MFA and JIT grants. Dual-approval for rewraps is possible using runbook service but adds latency. Need audit-proof evidence of approvals.

jonathan: Syslog: our ELK pipeline can forward but needs mapping to their JSON schema. We support TLS client certs. Throughput limit: 500 evt/s per forwarder node.

luis: Pseudonymize tenant ids in outgoing logs; keep sealed map internally for legal. Will loop in privacy and finance for retention cost.

maria: If HSM can't surface firmware hash, vendor may provide signed manifest. Samir open vendor ticket.

ops-bot: Note: forwarder alert threshold 450 events/sec, created INC-2024-447 for vendor firmware request.

maria: Action items: samir -> RBAC PRD with dual-approval fallback; jonathan -> syslog mapping prototype + cert handling; luis -> sealed mapping + retention proposal. Need draft by EOD tomorrow.
